item.title: Complete fall arrest harness Petzl Avao® International Version black
item.description: Petzl Avao® International Version is a complete system specially designed for workers at height, its design is specific for work positioning and rope descent. It has metal side attachment points, equipment hinges and tool holder slots, allowing the user to arrange all the necessary equipment for the working day. The contour foam on the semi-rigid belt and leg loops provides comfort during use. Adjustment is quick and easy with DOUBLEBACK self-locking buckles. Certified according to the standards of the USA, Europe, Great Britain, Japan.
